offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Token-based pricing: 1B tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); 11B tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens). Every search request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens.
offerings.price_basis: Jina Search Foundation API token usage
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Top five web results with URLs and contents in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five structured entries.
